discussion.body: FEAT-008 Hidden docks: Grok, presence, layers, style -- impl status: partial. dock-grok and dock-presence are mounted hidden in HiddenDocks. Layers is an inspector tab (data-ui=panel-layers), not a dedicated dock-layers aside. Style is inspect-style tab, not dock-style. How to verify: querySelector [data-ui=dock-grok] and [data-ui=dock-presence] exist hidden. Gap: no dock-layers or dock-style asides.
